one_line: A two-line family story in voiceover, then each benefit tied to something visible, ending with where to buy.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 dimmed top-down box on a table. Voiceover (transcript): a child found the box this morning before the gan. Orange words, one per second: "הבוקר", "מצא", "האיזון". At 0:03 a boy about 3 to 4 sits on the bike.
q1_hook.why: A voice opens a small story at once, said and shown word by word (H1, H6, H4). "The plan was to save it" at 0:03 sets up a twist that pays off by 0:08 (H5). The first picture is a dim, still box with no motion or face, a weak cover (H7, E1).

beats.what: Dimmed box seen from above, orange words one by one, voiceover starts the story
beats.why: A story starts in the first second

beats.what: Close-up of a boy about 3 to 4 on the bike; "התכנון היה לשמור"
beats.why: The plan, and the child already on the bike

beats.what: From above and behind, he rides along paved paths; "בקליק אחד וזהו אנחנו בדרך לגן"
beats.why: The twist lands: opened, built, riding

beats.what: He rides toward the lens, then away on asphalt; "אופני בטיחותיים", "קלה", "ללא צורך בניפוח"
beats.why: Each benefit meets a visible riding shot

beats.what: Dissolve to a hand holding the blue bike up; "הצבעים"
beats.why: A clear look at colour and style

beats.what: The bike hangs under a stroller; "נכנס ישר בעגלה"
beats.why: Shows the practical benefit, not just says it

beats.what: The boy sits on the bike, orange words "שילדים", "ווילי"
beats.why: Brand name said in a light moment

beats.what: A woman's legs push the stroller; "שניתן להשיג באתר"; the bike alone; black frame
beats.why: Where to buy, then a quiet close

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. The caption retells the sibling twist, a relatable moment a parent might send, but there is no question, save or share ask.
q2_flow.why: A tiny setup and twist in the first 12 s keeps the opening moving (K2, H5), then each benefit gets a new angle or dissolve every 3 s (R3). The feature run from 0:13 to 0:21 is voiceover over similar riding shots, the flattest stretch (R3, R1).

q3_cta.what: Subtitled and voiced 0:31 to 0:33: "שניתן להשיג באתר אפ פלפוט או בחנויות הנבחרות"; last words "נסיעה טובה" (transcript). Caption: tags @palphot, no link, no comment word, no price.
q3_cta.why: A single where-to-buy line comes after the benefits and is both said and shown (C6, C1). It gives a retailer but no link or price, and it sits in the bottom band over the footage (C6, T4). Nothing asks for a reply or a send.

q4_shown.what: The dimmed box at 0:00; a boy about 3 to 4 on the bike for most of the Reel; a hand holds the bike up at 0:22; the bike hangs under a stroller 0:25 to 0:29. No price. Assembly is said, not shown.
q4_shown.why: First-hand use of the bike, with benefits matched to what we see (tyres at 0:16, stroller fit at 0:25), is stronger than adjectives (S6, R3). The brand stays light, spoken once near the end (C7). A child's face with his name in the voice and caption is what LumeBook's Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 12 shots in 36 s (first pass: one hard cut, the rest dissolves), about 3 s each. Dissolves at 0:22 and 0:26. No speed changes seen. Orange single words alternate with small white lines. Ends on the bike alone, then a black frame.
q5_edit.why: Dissolves and a new angle every 3 s give a calm, steady pace (E2). Voiceover wall to wall with synced subtitles carries the message muted too (E4, T1). The black last frame adds a dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A morning-routine story: a toddler finds a balance bike meant for his sibling and rides it to the gan. It serves parents choosing a first bike.
q6_topic.why: A sibling twist is a relatable family moment with light humour (K3, K6). The practical features arrive inside the ride, not as a list (K4). The bike was a planned gift, but no occasion is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone footage in daylight outdoors: top-down on a table for the box; a close-up and from-above-behind shots of the boy riding; a hand-held POV of the bike; a low angle at the stroller. Mother only appears as legs.
q7_filmed.why: Sunlit handheld footage reads as a parent's own (H8, F7), and the hand holding the bike up is a clear POV (F5). The rider is small in the wide shots (F4), and the dimmed first frame with text low in the frame makes a weak cover (H7).

q8_text.on_screen: Big orange single words, about 90% down the frame, one per second: 0:00 "הבוקר", 0:01 "מצא", 0:02 "האיזון", 0:13 "אופני", 0:14 "בטיחותיים", 0:24 "הצבעים". Small white subtitle lines at the same height between them: 0:03 "התכנון היה לשמור", 0:20 "נושא משקל עד עשרים", 0:31 "שניתן להשיג באתר".
q8_text.caption: About 24 words, names replaced: "ואני חשבתי שאצליח לשמור את אופני האיזון ל[the younger child] אבל [the older child] כבר מצא אותם", a brand line ("אופני איזון שילדים אוהבים מבית ווילי"), a @palphot tag. No hashtags, no CTA, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Big single words are easy to read at once (T5) and the white lines label each benefit (T2), but all text sits in the bottom band under the buttons, and white lines fade on pale paving (T4, F2, T5). The caption has a story first line but few search words (T7). No disclosure (T8, S7).

weak_points: Dim still first frame; all text in the bottom band; text style switches mid-Reel; a black last frame; the child's face and name in voice and caption; assembly said but not shown; no price; no disclosure.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a table-top unboxing story in voiceover, hands only: the box, a page flip, the finished spread, each benefit tied to one visible shot.
not_verified: Whether the blue bike from 0:13 is the model on the box art (colours differ); the boy's age (about 3 to 4 is an estimate); music; whether the post was paid (coauthor palphot, no label). Cut count from the first pass. Voiceover quotes come from the transcript, which mishears some words.
